description: ADO-VIEW Sort and Filter on non-client cursors, SELECT ID, L, S FROM T ORDER BY ID: for a server forward-only, keyset, static and dynamic read-only Recordset assign Sort = "L DESC" (read back, ID order from MoveFirst) and Filter = "L = 20" (RecordCount, IDs); and a Recordset from Connection.Execute (default cursor) with the same. Asks which cursors accept Sort and Filter and with what errors.
